steps.code:
const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Camera/proprioception-only controller for VLABench hammer and picture task.
+
+Run from the rcb_client environment. The active policy uses small joint-position
+motions and a measured local hand Jacobian; no simulator state is accessed.
+"""
+from rcb_client import Robot
+import numpy as np
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+import sys
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+DT = 0.1
+OPEN = np.array([0.04, 0.04])
+
+def pose_from_proprio(p):
+    return np.asarray(p[16:19], dtype=float), np.asarray(p[19:23], dtype=float)
+
+def qmul(a, b):
+    w,x,y,z = a; W,X,Y,Z = b
+    return np.array([w*W-x*X-y*Y-z*Z,
+                     w*X+x*W+y*Z-z*Y,
+                     w*Y-x*Z+y*W+z*X,
+                     w*Z+x*Y-y*X+z*W])
+
+def qconj(q):
+    return np.array([q[0], -q[1], -q[2], -q[3]])
+
+def rotation_error(target, current):
+    dq = qmul(target, qconj(current))
+    dq /= np.linalg.norm(dq)
+    if dq[0] < 0: dq = -dq
+    s = np.linalg.norm(dq[1:])
+    if s < 1e-10: return 2*dq[1:]
+    return dq[1:] * (2*np.arctan2(s, dq[0])/s)
+
+def state(r):
+    p = np.asarray(r.status().get('proprio', {}).get('now', []), dtype=float)
+    if len(p) != 32:
+        obs = r.get_obs(cameras=[], video='none')
+        p = np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
+    return p[:7].copy(), *pose_from_proprio(p), p
+
+def command(r, q, fingers=OPEN, seconds=0.6, note=''):
+    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / DT)))
+    row = np.r_[np.asarray(q, dtype=float), np.asarray(fingers, dtype=float)]
+    res = r.submit('joint_position', np.repeat(row[None,:], n, axis=0), dt=DT,
+                   interpolate='linear', cameras=[], video='none', note=note)
+    if res.done:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"episode ended: {res.meta.get('reason')}")
+    now = np.asarray(res.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
+    return now[:7].copy(), *pose_from_proprio(now), now
+
+def calibrate_jacobian(r, eps=0.035, settle=0.5):
+    """Measure world translation and rotation per actual joint displacement."""
+    q0, x0, quat0, p0 = state(r)
+    samples_q = []
+    samples_twist = []
+    for j in range(7):
+        qt = q0.copy(); qt[j] += eps
+        qa, xa, quata, _ = command(r, qt, seconds=settle,
+                                    note=f'jacobian probe joint {j+1}')
+        dq = qa - q0
+        dr = np.r_[xa-x0, rotation_error(quata, quat0)]
+        if abs(dq[j]) > 1e-4:
+            samples_q.append(dq)
+            samples_twist.append(dr)
+        # Return to the observed baseline between probes.
+        command(r, q0, seconds=settle, note=f'return after joint {j+1} probe')
+    # A least-squares fit accounts for tiny motion in uncommanded joints.
+    Q = np.asarray(samples_q)
+    Y = np.asarray(samples_twist)
+    J = np.linalg.lstsq(Q, Y, rcond=None)[0].T
+    return q0, x0, quat0, J
+
+def cartesian_step(r, target_x, target_quat, max_joint_step=0.12):
+    q, x, quat, J = calibrate_jacobian(r)
+    error = np.r_[np.asarray(target_x)-x, rotation_error(target_quat, quat)]
+    # Position and angle have compatible weights after scaling rotation to a
+    # 0.18 m/rad equivalent, and DLS keeps the solution stable near singularities.
+    W = np.diag([1.,1.,1.,0.18,0.18,0.18])
+    A = W @ J
+    b = W @ error
+    lam = 0.025
+    dq = A.T @ np.linalg.solve(A @ A.T + lam*lam*np.eye(6), b)
+    peak = np.max(np.abs(dq))
+    if peak > max_joint_step: dq *= max_joint_step/peak
+    qcmd = np.clip(q+dq, np.array([-2.8973,-1.7628,-2.8973,-3.0718,-2.8973,-0.0175,-2.8973]),
+                   np.array([ 2.8973, 1.7628, 2.8973,-0.0698, 2.8973, 3.7525, 2.8973]))
+    return command(r, qcmd, seconds=0.9, note='Cartesian resolved-rate motion')
+
+def main():
+    r = Robot()
+    print('status', r.status())
+    mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'calibrate'
+    if mode == 'calibrate':
+        q, x, quat, J = calibrate_jacobian(r)
+        print('q', q.tolist())
+        print('tcp_xyz', x.tolist(), 'tcp_quat_wxyz', quat.tolist())
+        print('jacobian', J.tolist())
+        np.savez(OUT/'calibration.npz', q=q, x=x, quat=quat, J=J)
+    elif mode == 'hover_hammer':
+        # Forward-camera/depth deprojection: the wooden handle midpoint is at
+        # approximately (-0.06, 0.24, 0.78) in world coordinates.
+        target = np.array([-0.06, 0.24, 1.00])
+        q, x, quat, J = calibrate_jacobian(r)
+        for i in range(40):
+            q, x, quat, p = cartesian_step(r, target, quat)
+            print('step', i, 'tcp', x.tolist(), 'err', float(np.linalg.norm(target-x)),
+                  'q', q.tolist())
+            if np.linalg.norm(target-x) < 0.018:
+                break
+        o = r.get_obs(cameras=['forward','left','right','wrist'], video='none')
+        o.save(str(OUT/'hover_hammer'))
+        print('final', r.status())
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f'unknown mode {mode!r}')
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
text(r);
